sources.excerpt: The CFP Board of Managers voted in 2023 to expand the playoff to 12 teams beginning in 2024, an arrangement that will last through the end of the 2026 season. Beginning in 2027, the playoff will further expand to a 24-team playoff through the 2031 season.
Guaranteed bids for each champion of the four power conferences (ACC, Big Ten, Big 12, and SEC). All four conferences have agreed to no longer hold conference championship games.
At-large bids for the 19 remaining highest-ranked teams, which could include additional conference champions.
In college football, the College Football Playoff announces it will expand from 12 to 24 teams starting in the 2027 season.

The Chinese commerce ministry extends the suspension of export restrictions on certain rare earths, industrial diamonds, and lithium battery technology to January 10, 2027, amid ongoing trade negotiations with the United States.

The Pitt Rivers Museum in Oxford, England, United Kingdom, returns the remains of 39 Naga people, collected during the British Raj, to a delegation from Nagaland, India, following six years of discussions over repatriation.
A tiny fish with brilliant orange markings has been discovered in the Brazilian Amazon, but scientists warn that the newly identified species may already be at risk of extinction.

The new species, named Laimosemion laranja, belongs to a group of small freshwater fish known as killifish. It measures less than three centimeters in standard length, but its appearance is anything but ordinary.

Because its habitat is so restricted and faces multiple threats, the researchers believe the fish meets the criteria for classification as Endangered under guidelines established by the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN).
